name: Meetings Extract
description: Scan email cache for meeting-related threads and extract structured meeting packages. For each new meeting, enqueues the Gmail meeting label (and an archive if in the inbox and not watched) on email-updates; nothing when emailConfig.reportOnly is true.
prerequisite: Gmail OAuth via gog (email pipeline must be running)

name: Meetings Fetch Notes
description: Fetch Gemini doc transcripts and extract Fathom share-page content for meetings missing transcripts.

name: Meetings Ingest Notion
description: Poll a Notion inbox database for new meeting pages and ingest them into the meetings pipeline.
prerequisite: Notion API key + inbox database ID configured
